faqs.question: What is Apple Messages for Business?
faqs.answer: It's a service that lets businesses message customers directly inside the Messages app on iPhone and Mac, without customers needing to download a separate app.

faqs.question: How do I get a Business ID?
faqs.answer: You receive a Business ID from Apple after registering your company for Messages for Business through Apple's registration program.

faqs.question: What do Intent ID and Group ID do?
faqs.answer: They let you tell Apple Messages for Business the purpose of the chat and which department should handle it, so the conversation can be routed correctly from the very first message.

faqs.question: Can I pre-fill a message for customers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add a message and it will be pre-filled in the Messages app, so the customer only needs to tap Send to start the conversation.

faqs.question: Are there any character restrictions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Intent ID, Group ID, and the pre-filled message can't contain the reserved characters & # [ ] ( ) { } or /.

faqs.question: Does every entry point support Intent ID and Group ID routing?
faqs.answer: No. The Spotlight entry point does not support Intent or Group values. The link and QR code generated by this tool use the URL-based entry point, which does support both.

faqs.question: Can I use this link on both iPhone and Mac?
faqs.answer: Yes. Apple Messages for Business is supported on iPhones and Macs running compatible versions of iOS and macOS.
